caption: The drawing depicts a decorative wall plaque or shield composed mainly of a blue central area bordered by a segmented, stone-like, off-white or beige frame. At the top of the shield is a sculpted metallic or stone eagle with wings spread and a branch in its beak. The blue central area contains a motif of a smaller eagle at the center, encircled by a semicircle of thirteen yellow stars forming an arc above it. Below the shield, there is a fluted, shell-like metallic holder that supports a small, cylindrical brown container with a clasp/hook detail on its front. To the right of the main illustration, there is a smaller, monochrome or lightly colored sketch of the same shield and holder, showing its basic form without color or intricate detail. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. The name "Alfred E. Koerner" appears in small letters in the lower left corner.
title: Sconce
